description: This PHP source file defines a controller class `SaleOrder` in the OpenCart admin system. The class manages sale order reports, including displaying report forms, saving settings, and generating report data for rendering views. It includes methods for handling HTTP requests, permissions, interacting with models, and rendering templates.

classes.name: SaleOrder
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale order reports in the OpenCart admin backend, providing methods for viewing, saving, and generating report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Prepares and renders the sale order report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings, with permission check, responding with JSON.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Prepares report data and renders the report view with date ranges and order statuses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the sale order report list, delegating to getReport.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates report data based on filters, pagination, and renders the report list view.
